COMMERCIAL PREMISES OF 52 M² WITH AIR CONDITIONING IN A VERY GOOD LOCATION

LA CASA AGENCY presents this commercial space of 52 m² built, located at street level with direct access to the outside, offering excellent visibility and easy access.

The premises have air conditioning and a layout that offers multiple possibilities for developing different types of commercial activity.

RENTAL PRICE: €750/MONTH

Excellent location

It is located in a consolidated and busy area, surrounded by schools, high schools, parks, and shops, and is very well connected by public transport.

In addition, it is close to the Marítim and Ayora Metro stations, facilitating access for both customers and employees.

Main features:

52 m² built
Street-level premises
Direct exit to the street
Air conditioning
Close to schools and high schools
Near parks
Close to Marítim and Ayora Metro
Very good location

An excellent opportunity to establish your business in an area with services, traffic, and good connections.

Alex Pellitero – 6.6. 2.2. 0.7. 1.9. 7.
